explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this theorem. It says that the normalized Atkin–Lehner operator preserves the library's Petersson inner product over cosets on cusp forms for Γ₁(N). Searching Mathlib for `AtkinLehner`, `atkinLehner` and `peterssonInner` returned no hits. The word "petersson" appears in only two files, `NumberTheory/ModularForms/Petersson.lean` and `Bounds.lean`, which define the pointwise Petersson function. Mathlib has neither an inner product over coset representatives nor Atkin–Lehner operators. The current proof only rewrites with the library's own lemmas (`peterssonInnerCosets_smul_left`/`_right`, `peterssonInnerCosets_atkinLehnerOperatorGamma1Cusp`, `atkinLehnerNormalizer_sq_mul`), so all of its mathematical content comes from the library's own definitions.
